fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Certification of no criminal record * 2. Bank Statement RMB 40,000 or above. You can download a template or sample from here . * 3. General physical checkup form for foreigners(only valid for 6 months) Please take it to hospital to have a checkup with all items, including personal information, photo, checking date, doctors' suggestion and signature. * 4. This material do not need to fill in, but must submit with Financial Support Statement You can download a template or sample from here . * 5. HSK Level 4 Certificate No need for TCSOL students. * 6. Copy of passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included (Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 7. 3 Passport photos * 8. High school diploma Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. Prospective diploma recipients must submit official document issued by your current school to prove your current student status or expected graduation date. * 9. High school transcript Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. * 10. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Applicants must be between 18 and 35 years old, hold a non-Chinese nationality, and meet the requirements of the Ministry of Education Document No. 12 [2020]. 2.Applicants should have good conduct, be in sound physical and mental health, and comply with Chinese laws and regulations as well as the rules and regulations of Tianjin Foreign Studies University. 3.Applicants for undergraduate programs must have a high school diploma. 4.For Chinese-taught programs, applicants must hold a Chinese Proficiency Test (HSK) Level 4 certificate with a score of 180 or above.
